snippet.title: The Last Faith: Awakened Ancients DLC Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Something stirs on the horizon: news worth your excitement is here. Awakened Ancients, The Last Faith’s first DLC, will descend January 20, 2026.

Coming to Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch.
